source_text: ⸂ἐπιβλέψητε δὲ⸃ ἐπὶ τὸν φοροῦντα τὴν ἐσθῆτα τὴν λαμπρὰν καὶ ⸀εἴπητε· Σὺ κάθου ὧδε καλῶς, καὶ τῷ πτωχῷ εἴπητε· Σὺ στῆθι ⸂ἢ κάθου ἐκεῖ⸃ ὑπὸ τὸ ὑποπόδιόν μου,
english_snapshot: and if you pay attention to the one wearing the bright clothing and say[a], “You sit here in a good place,” and say to the poor man, “You stand there[b], or sit under my footstool,”

signals.text: Some manuscripts omit “or sit there,” leaving simply “You stand there, or sit under my footstool” in others; the printed text includes “or sit there.”
